offering_description.value: Owns and operates casinos with gaming floors, restaurants and hotels in the US, Canada and Europe, serving gamblers and visitors who pay wagers at tables and slot machines and spend on food, drink and rooms.

primary_services.value: casino gaming; hotel accommodation; food and beverage; entertainment events

customer_segment.value: B2C: Casino patrons, local gamblers, travelers and visitors to resort and hotel properties

revenue_model.value: other: gaming wagers: net gaming revenue from table games and slot machines; product sales: food, beverage and retail sales at on-site restaurants and bars; service fees: hotel rooms, event and entertainment admissions

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in gaming wagers and visitor spending, sells gambling and hospitality experiences to individual patrons; asset operator: owns and runs casino, hotel and restaurant properties in several countries

geography_served.value: global: US: Colorado, Missouri, Indiana, Canada: Ontario, Alberta, Europe: Poland, Germany, Austria, also South Africa and other international operations

specialization.value: niche specialist: casino gaming, with hotels and restaurants supporting the casino properties

distribution_channels.value: own locations: casino properties operated by the company

regulatory_exposure.value: high: casino gaming licenses and operating permits from state, provincial and national gaming regulators in each country

notes: Property list, ownership and management status may have changed; details are approximate.
